annotations.title: Read a job from its link

description: Reads the posting at an employer or job-board link and returns the full posting text, the match assessment against the user and the job id, keeping it in the user's saved jobs. Fetches the employer's page; applies to nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Repeating a call with the same key and arguments returns its first result instead of acting again.

url.description: The posting URL the user shared.

name: get_job_from_link

outputSchema.description: One posting: its facts, its match assessment and its text.

application_status.description: The application's ledger status when the user applied to this job, else null.

apply_supported.description: Whether ApplySent can fill and submit this posting's form by itself.

apply_url.description: The employer's posting URL, where the application is filled.

country.description: Country the posting is in, as the catalogue recorded it.

description.description: The posting's text with whitespace collapsed, cut to the tool's length.

description_truncated.description: True when the posting's text was cut.

facts.description: Facts the catalogue derived from the posting; a key is absent when the catalogue established nothing for it.

employment_type.description: Employment type the posting states, e.g. full_time or contract.

form_fields.description: How many fields the employer's form has, when it was read.

industry.description: Industry the catalogue derived from the title and department.

nationals_only.description: 1 when the posting is open only to a country's nationals.

salary_currency.description: ISO code of the stated pay.

salary_max.description: Highest stated pay, in the currency's units.

salary_min.description: Lowest stated pay, in the currency's units.

salary_period.description: What the stated pay is for: year, month, week, day or hour.

seniority.description: Seniority the posting states or its title and text imply.

skills.description: The skills the posting names, as a JSON array inside a string, when it names any.

tailored_keywords.description: Keywords the tailored résumé added, when one was made.

items.description: One keyword the tailored résumé added.

visa_sponsorship.description: 1 when the posting offers visa sponsorship, 0 when it refuses it.

work_permit.description: What the posting's country means for the user's work authorization, in words.

workplace.description: Where the work is done: remote, hybrid or onsite.

id.description: The job id the other job tools take.

match.description: The assessment of this job against the user's résumé, targets and eligibility.

additionalProperties.description: Points this factor added to the score.

breakdown.description: Points each match factor added; a full job read carries them, a list row does not.

eligible.description: Whether the user may take this job: work authorization, language and the posting's stated requirements all pass.

missing.description: What the assessment could not establish about the user for this posting; a full job read carries it, a list row does not.

items.description: One fact the assessment could not establish about the user.

notes.description: Notes the assessment kept beside the score; a full job read carries them, a list row does not.

items.description: One note the assessment kept beside the score.

reasons.description: Why the job scores what it does, in words.

items.description: One reason the job scored as it did.

score.description: Match score from 0 to 100 against the user's résumé and targets; higher is better.

posted_at.description: When the posting went up, ISO 8601 in UTC, when the catalogue knows it.

provider.description: The employer's hiring system the posting came from, e.g. workday, greenhouse or ashby.

salary.description: The pay the posting states, or null when it states none.

currency.description: ISO code of the stated pay.

max.description: Highest amount the posting states, in the currency's units.

min.description: Lowest amount the posting states, in the currency's units.

period.description: What the amounts are for (year, month, week, day or hour) when the posting states a period ApplySent recognizes.

saved.description: Whether the user saved this job.

title.description: The posting's title as the employer states it.

title: Read a job from its link
